title: PGP / OpenPGP — deployment profile
description: Pretty Good Privacy (PGP), written by Phil Zimmermann in 1991, brought strong public-key encryption to ordinary email users. The OpenPGP format is standardized in RFC 4880 and implemented by GnuPG. Filed as JAH-CRY-000011 in the JAH Cryptography Database archive.
